svg.title: Figure 06 · Interpolation is a modelling decision
svg.desc: Three interpolants pass through identical discount nodes. Forward jumps are sampled on a fine grid and connected for display; at a knot the one-sided derivative must be specified. The inspector interpolates the displayed samples, not an undefined derivative at the knot.
